description: Major Northern California wildfires 2017-2025 (>= ~37k acres or Butte County), used for the historical fire-direction prior and refuge/corridor history terms. Ignition points: NIFC WFIGS (2020+) and CAL FIRE incident pages (2017-2019). Perimeters themselves come from CAL FIRE FRAP at bundle build (perimeters.json).

fires.name: Tubbs
fires.wind: NE Diablo wind, gusts 60+ mph; spread SW into Santa Rosa overnight
fires.source: CAL FIRE incident page https://www.fire.ca.gov/incidents/2017/10/8/tubbs-fire (origin Bennett Lane, Calistoga); not fetched live, entered 2026-10-24

fires.name: Carr
fires.source: CAL FIRE incident page https://www.fire.ca.gov/incidents/2018/7/23/carr-fire (origin Hwy 299 at Carr Powerhouse Rd); not fetched live

fires.name: Camp
fires.wind: NE Jarbo Gap wind 30-50 mph; fire ran SW from Pulga through Concow into Paradise within ~3 h
fires.source: CAL FIRE incident page https://www.fire.ca.gov/incidents/2018/11/8/camp-fire (origin Camp Creek Rd near Pulga; CAL FIRE/Butte County DA investigation 2020); not fetched live

fires.name: Kincade

fires.source: CAL FIRE incident page https://www.fire.ca.gov/incidents/2019/10/23/kincade-fire (origin Burned Mountain Rd, Geyserville); not fetched live
